subject: Media Literacy
title: Cold War Information Warfare
description: A fast breakdown of Cold War Information Warfare for builders.

hook.text: The CIA secretly funded literary magazines, art exhibits, and jazz concerts to fight Soviet influence.

buildup.text: The Cold War was fought with ideas as much as weapons. Both sides waged a propaganda war.

discovery.text: Radio Free Europe broadcast Western news into Soviet countries, reaching millions behind the Iron Curtain.

twist.text: The Soviets used the same tools: state media, cultural exports, and disinformation campaigns.

climax.text: The Cold War proved that information control could be as powerful as nuclear weapons.

punchline.text: The Cold War was won in living rooms, not on battlefields.

quiz.question: How did the CIA fight Cold War propaganda?
options: By secretly funding cultural projects and media
